aboutIntro: I help businesses build reliable, secure, and scalable backend systems that power websites, mobile applications, admin dashboards, and SaaS platforms.
aboutText:
I am a Backend Developer with strong experience in building web applications, RESTful APIs, admin dashboards, and business management systems using Laravel and modern backend development practices.

My work focuses on creating clean, maintainable, and scalable backend architecture that supports real business operations. I have experience working with authentication systems, role-based permissions, database design, payment gateway integrations, third-party APIs, notifications, file management, reporting modules, and performance optimization.

I care about writing organized code, improving system structure, protecting production data, and delivering solutions that are easy to maintain and extend. Whether the project is a new system, a mobile app backend, a SaaS platform, or a refactor for an existing Laravel project, I focus on building backend solutions that are stable, practical, and ready for growth.
